text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The problem of resolving the tax debts of soccer clubs is in the hands of Economy Minister Augusto Mateus.
- Banco Comercial Portugues 1996 net consolidated profit rose 14.8 percent year-on-year to 23.268 billion escudos.
- A Spanish group may be interested in buying Portuguese tourism company Sopete, based in Povoa-do-Varzim in northern Portugal.
- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said the budget of the Expo 1998 World Fair would increase.
- Sales of ship repairer Lisnave were 30 billion escudos in 1996, up from 23.5 billion in 1995.
